answer: At the network summit each new agent must stake an ivory‑colored token on a verifiable hardware enclave before receiving a recruitment voucher. The voucher can only be redeemed if the recruiter’s ledger shows a proven ledge of at least five downstream agents that have also staked, otherwise the reward reverts to zero. An attacker must therefore purchase and physically secure dozens of tokens and hardware slots, inflating the cost far beyond the profit of a Sybil flood.
